from pathlib import Path
import csv,json,statistics,hashlib,sys
root=Path('D:/S-760');base=Path(__file__).parent/'scheduler-after'
validation=json.loads((base/'validation.json').read_text());results=[]
for direction in ['up','down']:
 source=base/'native'/f'scheduler-{direction}.csv'
 with source.open() as f:
  assert next(f).strip()=='# dropped=0'
  rows=[{k:(float(v) if k=='seconds' else v if k=='kind' else int(v)) for k,v in r.items()} for r in csv.DictReader(f)]
 entries=[r for r in rows if r['kind']=='timer-read' and r['curpc']==0xcb00]
 assert len(entries)==25
 assert {(r['data']-int(r['seconds']*1e6+1e-5))&65535 for r in entries}=={0}
 intervals=[]
 for previous,current in zip(entries,entries[1:]):
  rearm=next(r for r in rows if r['kind']=='register-write' and r['address']==4 and r['curpc']==0xcb51 and previous['seconds']<r['seconds']<current['seconds'])
  assert ((rearm['data']-previous['data'])&65535)==20000
  due=(int(previous['seconds']*1e6+1e-5)+20000)/1e6
  vector=next(r for r in rows if r['kind']=='vector-read' and r['address']==0x200a and due-1e-9<=r['seconds']<=current['seconds'])
  assert vector['data']==0xcad1
  latency=(vector['seconds']-due)*1e6;prologue=(current['seconds']-vector['seconds'])*1e6
  assert abs(prologue-8.875)<1e-5
  context=[r for r in rows if due-0.0003<=r['seconds']<=vector['seconds']]
  masked=[r for r in context if due<=r['seconds']<=vector['seconds'] and not(r['psw']&0x200)]
  handshake=None
  if latency>2 and vector['code_page']==0x4b and vector['curpc']==0x5812:
   starts=[r for r in rows if r['kind']=='stack-write' and r['code_page']==0x4b and r['curpc']==0x57b4 and r['seconds']<=due]
   start=starts[-1]
   ends=[r for r in rows if r['kind']=='stack-read' and r['code_page']==0x4b and r['curpc']==0x5811 and start['seconds']<=r['seconds']<=vector['seconds']]
   assert ends and masked
   end=ends[-1]
   handshake={'pusha_observed':start,'popa_observed':end,'observed_stack_endpoint_span_us':(end['seconds']-start['seconds'])*1e6,'post_restore_delivery_us':(vector['seconds']-end['seconds'])*1e6}
  interval={'previous_entry':previous,'rearm':rearm,'due_seconds':due,'next_entry':current,'vector':vector,'period_us':(current['seconds']-previous['seconds'])*1e6,'delivery_delay_us':latency,'prologue_us':prologue,'handshake':handshake,'masked_snapshots_after_due':masked,'context':context}
  assert abs((current['seconds']-previous['seconds'])*1e6-(20000+current['data']-rearm['data'])%65536)<1.01
  intervals.append(interval)
 measured=[r['period_us'] for r in intervals];delivery=[r['delivery_delay_us'] for r in intervals]
 results.append({'direction':direction,'rows':len(rows),'timer_intervals':len(intervals),'rearms_exact_20000':len(intervals),'mean_period_ms':statistics.mean(measured)/1000,'mean_delivery_delay_us':statistics.mean(delivery),'maximum_delivery_delay_us':max(delivery),'mean_prologue_us':statistics.mean(r['prologue_us'] for r in intervals),'handshake_delayed_intervals':sum(r['handshake'] is not None for r in intervals),'delayed_delivery_contexts':[{'code_page':r['vector']['code_page'],'curpc':r['vector']['curpc'],'delay_us':r['delivery_delay_us']} for r in intervals if r['delivery_delay_us']>2],'intervals':intervals,'csv_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
for row in validation['rows']:assert row['observed_equals_unobserved'] and row['repeated_unobserved_exact'] and row['observer']['dropped']==0
image=(root/'S760224.IMG').read_bytes();analysis=json.loads((root/'docs/ic20-hle-findings/chatGPT-work/os-reconciled-review-2026-10-16/analysis.json').read_text());anchors={}
for region in analysis['regions']:
 for ins in region['instructions']:
  if (ins['page']==0 and ins['pc'] in [0xcad1,0xcb00,0xcb51,0xcb5b]) or (ins['page']==0x4b and 0x57b4<=ins['pc']<=0x5812):
   raw=bytes.fromhex(ins['bytes']);assert image[ins['file_offset']:ins['file_offset']+len(raw)]==raw;anchors[f"{ins['page']:04X}:{ins['pc']:04X}"]=ins
report={'date':'2026-10-16','bug':'BUG-005','status':'After documented CPU state-time correction; filter BUG-005 remains OPEN','matched_state_validation':validation,'results':results,'original_instruction_anchors':anchors,'classification':'After six documented two-state instruction corrections, these new half-second windows show near20.009ms cadence and8.875us prologue. Scheduling phase differs across fresh runs; no general or hardware waveform accuracy claim.','limitations':['Current-build same-state observer/baseline/repeat PCM exact; no hardware interrupt/control-write timestamp measured.','Sampled PSW observations plus decodedPUSHA/POPA paths localize delay; they are not a continuous hardware bus trace.','Half-second windows are not full-ramp/voice-load timing bounds.','Does not interpret companion command101018 or prove filter ASIC transition behavior.','Original firmware and DSP equations unchanged; six native KB instruction-state counts corrected from4 to2. Legacy timing unchanged.','Older matched runs used different executable identity and are corroborating history, not silently pooled.'],'identities':{str(p.relative_to(root)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in [root/'mame-source/mames760.exe',root/'roms/BOOT/Roland_S-760_v1.11.BIN',root/'S760224.IMG',root/'mame-source/src/devices/cpu/mcs96/mcs96.cpp',root/'mame-source/src/devices/cpu/mcs96/i8x9x.cpp',root/'mame-source/src/mame/roland/s760.cpp',Path(__file__),Path(__file__).parent/'run_matched_after.py']},'analysis_source':Path(__file__).read_text()}
(root/'docs/condensed/validation/filter-scheduler-after-state-time-fix-2026-10-16.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps([{k:v for k,v in r.items() if k!='intervals'} for r in results]))
